Mail._comment: A fallback for before an administrator has set the mail server up under System settings, which is where it belongs. Host is deliberately blank: a placeholder host is worse than none, because SmtpEmailSender's 'no mail server is configured' guard tests it, and any non-empty value sends the app off to time out against a host that does not exist instead of saying plainly that nothing is configured.

Seed._comment: Set both via environment variables/secrets on first deploy only, to create the single initial Admin account. Remove them afterwards. This never overwrites an existing account.

DevTools._comment: EnableDatabaseReset must stay false on any deployment holding real user data. Only turn it on for a shared environment the team uses purely to build/test against, e.g. while there's no frontend yet.
